name: map-reduce
title: One joke per subject, written in parallel, then judged

comparison.purpose: Lists subjects for a topic, spawns one joke writer per subject in parallel, collects the jokes as they land, and has a judge pick the best by index. The fan-out width is capped, a failed branch records a placeholder instead of stalling the run, and an out-of-range pick is retried once before the run ends in failed.
